beats: Some places along the route stayed silent forever — there just wasn't enough written about them.
Once skipped, a place stayed skipped — nothing ever came back to look harder.
Now a separate nightly process digs deeper — old newspapers, local-history archives, forgotten books.
It even scans nearby Wikidata records, promoting forgotten spots like old mills and dairies into the route.
So every silent place gets a second look through five more real sources before it's given up on.
